subject: Re: Kickoff: Reviews2Movielens as a first-class internal benchmark
body:
Wrapping decisions ahead of internal GA on May 15.

1. Leaderboard went live April 20 (three days late, fine) and already has four teams submitting. Nice work Leilani.
2. Baselines: Yusuf's entity-representation model posts 0.412 mean average precision on tag prediction over the scored split; that's our published reference number for GA.
3. Scope cut: we will NOT ship the review-level sentiment labels this half. The extra label pass would push us past mid-May and nobody has a committed use case. Revisit at Q3 planning — note OKRs lock June 26.
4. Docs: Freya to fold the mapping-accuracy caveat (97% on a 200-sample audit) into the dataset card so downstream teams stop re-asking.

GA announcement goes out May 15. Thanks everyone — this one's been smooth.

Dmitri
